verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a data pipeline platform with Reverse ETL syncs, but the evidence never mentions a recurring schedule. The closest item is an API to programmatically run Reverse ETL syncs, which is a one-off trigger, not a recurring schedule. Warehouse sync and 'continuous' consent sync claims also do not document scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
